mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we have clear conditions near City Hall under a waning gibbous moon. The ISS will be visible tomorrow morning at 5:07 AM, rising over Middleton near Verona High School and heading toward Fitchburg and Madison, reaching halfway up the sky. The overnight low will hit 40 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain.

The City of Verona has announced that alternate-side winter parking rules apply from November 20 through April 1, requiring you to park on even or odd sides of the street depending on the date. Also, remember that the Verona Senior Center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving.

There is plenty to do in town today, including yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 activities, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, plus the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event.
In a report from October 25, officers found a man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I, first offence.

The delicious flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store is currently open but will be closing its doors in less than an hour, so try to make it there before they finish up for the night.
